title: Five Unique Blessings of Ramadan
summary: A hadith describes five unique blessings of Ramadan given to the Prophet's community.
translation: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (may Allah be pleased with him): The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said that my community has been granted five unique distinctions in the blessed Ramadan that were not given to any other community. Firstly, the smell from the mouth of a fasting person is more beloved to Allah than musk. Secondly, during this time, the fish in the sea seek forgiveness for them until they break their fast. Thirdly, Allah adorns His paradise every day and then says, 'Soon My righteous servants will cast off their hardships and come to you.' Fourthly, the rebellious devils are locked up during Ramadan, so they cannot reach the evils they would during other times. Fifthly, on the last night of Ramadan, their forgiveness is granted. It was asked if this forgiveness was granted on the Night of Decree, to which he replied, 'No, but the common practice is that the laborer is fully paid upon completing their task.'
